lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I saw that you went home early today.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What're you up to?
Are we going with a teacher-student dynamic today?
Never mind that. Did you do your homework?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'll play the role of a student

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: who's always following her teacher around.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're a really strict teacher.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But seriously, what were you actually up to?
Before going to bed,
I was just preparing for tomorrow's lesson.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, you're playing along.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We're continuing with the roleplay then?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Got it. Here goes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You must have so much work to do, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I helped you after class today,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and yet you still have more work to do at home?
Such is the life of a teacher.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That sounds really rough.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'll stay and help you tomorrow too.
It's okay.
That's not your responsibility as a student.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I always review what we study in class,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and do all my homework on time.
Still, I don't know if I should be getting help from a student...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: When a student follows a teacher around,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and tries to help him with as much as she can,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: it usually means something. Do you know what that is?
That... she's a good student?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Most students don't help teachers without wanting something in return.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Nine times out of ten,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: it's to get better grades or extra credit.
And what about the one out of ten?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That one wants the teacher's heart.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: She wants to spend time together outside of class.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: See, for a student there's only one teacher,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but for a teacher there are many students.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So the way the student says,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: "I want you to notice me,"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: is by following you around.
Which are you, Arcana? One of the nine out of ten, or the one?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Honestly...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want you to notice me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wait, let me rephrase that.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I want you to notice only me.
Erm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... is what the student Arcana would say to her teacher in this little roleplay!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What'd you think?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you were the teacher, would you fall for a student like that?
If you pushed a little more, I would have.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well, you'd better get your heart ready then,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: because the way I treated that teacher,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: is exactly how I can treat you too.
I'll be ready.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good. I'll be looking forward to

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: how you respond.
